Class NetSystem

java.lang.Object
QueueNet.NetSystem
public class NetSystem extends Object
This class controls the simulation running. It should be used to :
  • start the simulation;
  • stop the simulation;
  • abort the simulation;
  • get simulation elapsed time;
  • get total simulation time;
  • get real elapsed time.
Note that all methods are static and the class should not be instanced.
Author:
Francesco Radaelli, Federico Granata, Stefano Omini Modified by Bertoli Marco: fixed bug that avoided simulation termination with closed classes. 22-09-2005

      public void terminate()
      Terminates NetSystem and closes the log. You should recall the initialize method, rebuild all the network nodes and recall the start method in order to launch a new simulation.
